SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE", 
       (et."type_indices"->>'safety_idx')::numeric / 100 * 
       ((et."type_indices"->>'performance_score')::numeric + e."RELIAB_IDX") / 2 * 
       (1 - (et."type_indices"->>'environmental_impact_idx')::numeric / 100) * 0.8 as OSPI
FROM "Equipment" e 
JOIN "EquipmentType" et ON e."EquipType" = et."EquipType" 
WHERE e."EquipType" = 'Vehicle' 
ORDER BY OSPI DESC LIMIT 5;
